description: A trigger generator for one clock division, firing or staying silent at each division by chance, and taking its randomness from an Omen to its left

params.text: Sets how often a division fires, 0 to 100%; with a cable in the jack below it this becomes an attenuator on that voltage instead
Picks which of 128 fixed random patterns this module follows, so the same seed can give a different rhythm here

inputs.text: Sets how often a division fires, -5V for never and +5V for always, scaled down by the slider above it
While this is at 0.1V or more no triggers leave the module, though the pattern keeps running underneath
A rising edge past 2V puts the pattern back to its first step

outputs.text: A 10V pulse 1ms long on each division the pattern fires

notes: this module does nothing on its own; it needs an Omen to its left, directly or through a chain of Tyche modules, and a clock patched into that Omen
the lamp on the slider is yellow when a division fires, red when one would have fired but the mute input stopped it, and dark otherwise
a Kron muted by another Kron placed further left in the chain is one sample behind, and the mute does not take effect; the maker records this as an open problem
menu: Division: 1/2, 1/2t, 1/2., 1/4, 1/4t, 1/4., 1/8, 1/8t, 1/8., 1/16, 1/16t, 1/16. — picks how often the module gets a chance to fire

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the slider's own full 100%; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
high above 0.1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
